SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT PLANT, QUOTATION_NO, QUOTATION_SEQ, REVISION_NO FROM TBL_KEP_RE WHERE IF_FLAG = 'N' ORDER BY PLANT, QUOTATION_NO, QUOTATION_SEQ, REVISION_NO
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'HYOS' AS BUYER , 'KA' AS SITE , PLANT , QUOTATION_NO , QUOTATION_SEQ , REVISION_NO AS REVISION , STATUS , ADD_DATE , BUYER_ITEM_NO , DESCRIPTION , SPECIFICATION , UNIT_MEASURE , MAKER_NAME , UNIT_PRICE , LEGACY_PR_NO , LEGACY_PR_SEQ , RD_DATE , REQ_USER_ID , REQ_USER_NAME , REQ_USER_DEPT_NAME , REQ_USER_TELNO , REQ_USER_MAIL , CLOSE_DATE , CLOSE_TIME , ITEM_QTY , PR_USER_NAME ||'^'|| PR_USER_TELNO ||'^'|| PR_USER_DEPT_NAME ||'^'|| REMARK AS REMARK FROM TBL_KEP_RE WHERE PLANT = '$G_RS.PLANT$' AND QUOTATION_NO = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND QUOTATION_SEQ= '$G_RS.QUOTATION_SEQ$' AND REVISION_NO = '$G_RS.REVISION_NO$'
UPDATE TBL_KEP_RE SET IF_FLAG = 'Y' , IF_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE PLANT = '$G_RS.PLANT$' AND QUOTATION_NO = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND QUOTATION_SEQ= '$G_RS.QUOTATION_SEQ$' AND REVISION_NO = '$G_RS.REVISION_NO$'
